Maya (Partnerships): Heads-up: vendors sent staggered availability windows. We need a marketplace onramp plan that covers: SKU naming conventions, firmware/kernel dependencies, SI dry-run, and an embargo/rehearsal for joint announcement. Can we align next week?
Victor (Eng Infra): Firmware timelines differ. H100 image + NV driver expected by 2025-06-05; H200 via vendor B on 2025-06-12; MI300 needs ROCm build 2025-05-28. We must lock image hashes to avoid drift.
Ria (Platform PM): Marketplace requirements: SKU id, short description (<=80 chars), region tags, cpu/gpu counts, and compat matrix. Also validate marketplace API schema before publishing.
Diego (SI): SI ask: a reproducible test suite (small eval + perf) and a recovery checklist for node flakiness. Prefer vendor engineer pairing during first install.
Tasha (Marketing): Rehearsal: we want a dry-run of the partner webinar + press embargo at least 1 week before live. Two possible announce slots: 2025-07-14 or 2025-08-04. Need legal thumbs-up before committing.
Omar (Legal): Please provide exact list of partners to be named and the embargo timestamps (ISO TZ). Also need vendor-provided PR approval SLA (48h). No logos without written OK.
Ivy (Ops): Lab booking: can host 6 H100, 6 H200/B200 mixed, 4 MI300, 5 Gaudi for 3 weeks starting 2025-06-22. We can extend if the dry-run reveals infra gaps.
Maya (Partnerships): Contingency: if H100 stock delayed, propose fallback routing prioritization: 1) H200 quota, 2) B200 quantized models, 3) host fallback to smaller sequence SLO for latency-sensitive calls. Approve?
Victor (Eng Infra): Agree. Need quantization profiles for B200 and knob for sequence truncation in runtime. Also implement canary ratio control: 5% traffic to fallback for 48h.
Ria (Platform PM): For marketplace listing preview, can we enable preview mode in Console for marketing/partners? We should show SKU tiles + perf badges (p99 latency, throughput).
Ivy (Ops): Yes, will create preview workspace. Ria please give the sample p95/p99 numbers and model names by 2025-06-10.
Diego (SI): SI runbook items: install steps, model weights placement, common kernel errors, rollback command set. I'll draft and circulate.
ReleaseBot: NOTE: release candidate marketplace.yml schema validation failed on branch feature/market-sku (error: missing region_tags).
Maya (Partnerships): Action items: Maya -> collect vendor embargo windows; Victor -> lock image hashes + quant profiles; Ria -> marketplace schema + preview; Diego -> SI runbook; Tasha -> rehearsal schedule; Omar -> embargo template + PR SLA; Ivy -> lab reservation. Due dates: vendor windows by 2025-05-30; image hashes by 2025-06-03; schema/preview by 2025-06-10; runbook by 2025-06-12; rehearsal assets by 2025-07-01.
Tasha (Marketing): Also need art assets and speaker list by 2025-06-24.
Omar (Legal): I'll post a vendor-approved embargo template in the shared drive and add a checklist for logo usage.
Victor (Eng Infra): Small tech note: please include a minimal curl check for marketplace validation. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/marketplace/validate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -F "file=@marketplace.yml"
```
Ria (Platform PM): Good. Also add acceptance tests that simulate 10k qps for throughput badges; we can fake traffic in preview.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks. Will ping vendors and lock windows. Post updates here once vendor times are confirmed. :v:
